title: Return of the Runners
subtitle: A fan remake of Lode Runner: The Legend Returns
controls: Arrow keys: run and climb. Z / X: dig left / right. C: pick up or drop an item. V: use a tool. B: lay a bomb. Collect all the gold: the exit appears. Carry a key to its door to open it. Trap the monks in holes.
levelError: This level could not be loaded.
editorHint: Left button: paint the selected tile. Right button: erase. Keys 1–9 and 0: pick a tile. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y: undo / redo.
testHint: Arrow keys: run and climb. Z / X: dig left / right. C: pick up or drop an item. V: use a tool. B: lay a bomb. Esc: back to the editor.

editorLinkHint: Click a teleporter entrance, then the exit it should lead to. A new entrance leads to the nearest exit.
controls2: Player 1: arrow keys, . and / to dig, comma to pick up, M to use a tool, N to lay a bomb. Player 2: W A S D, Q and E to dig, R to pick up, F to use a tool, G to lay a bomb. Collect all the gold: as soon as one player reaches the exit, the level is won.
controlsVersus: Player 1: arrow keys, . and / to dig, comma to pick up, M to use a tool, N to lay a bomb. Player 2: W A S D, Q and E to dig, R to pick up, F to use a tool, G to lay a bomb. Race for the gold: once it is all taken, the first player to reach an exit wins.
testHint2: Player 1: arrow keys, . and / to dig, comma to pick up, M to use a tool, N to lay a bomb. Player 2: W A S D, Q and E to dig, R to pick up, F to use a tool, G to lay a bomb. Esc: back to the editor.
versusDraw: Draw: both players got out together! Playing it again…
